threads.author: xiaobai
threads.title: 萌新求问：模型从零开始到底先干啥
threads.titleEn: Total beginner: what do you actually do first?

floors.author: xiaobai
floors.text: 下了个训练工具，界面一堆按钮，点「训练」它说没数据。
floors.textEn: Downloaded a training tool. Lots of buttons. I hit Train and it says there is no data.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 没数据练个寂寞。先自己动手标，几十条就能跑第一轮。手标还有个好处：标多了你就知道它难在哪。
floors.textEn: No data, nothing to train. Label some yourself first; a few dozen is enough for a first run. Labelling by hand also shows you what is hard about the task.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 标的时候别乱点。标错的数据比没有数据还坑，它会把错的学进去。
floors.textEn: Do not click at random while labelling. Wrong labels are worse than none; it learns the mistakes.

floors.author: yanglaji
floors.text: 嫌手标慢就买现成数据集，MNIST 六万张一次到位。不过先把钱留着买该买的。
floors.textEn: If hand labelling is too slow, buy a ready dataset: MNIST gives you sixty thousand at once. But keep money for what you really need.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 有了数据：训练几轮 → 看每轮考的分数。分数不涨了，就该想想是数据不够还是结构不对。
floors.textEn: Once you have data: train a few epochs, evaluate once, look at the score. Without evaluating you never know where it stands.

floors.author: chigua
floors.text: 听着跟带小孩写作业一个流程。
floors.textEn: Sounds exactly like supervising a kid's homework.

threads.author: dengdeng
threads.title: 靠接外包攒显卡钱，说说我的经验
threads.titleEn: Saving for a GPU with freelance jobs: my experience

floors.author: dengdeng
floors.text: 最开始是在平台上帮人标图，一张几毛钱。干得久了平台给你升级，同样一张给得更多。
floors.textEn: I started labelling images on a platform for a few mao each. Stay long enough and they promote you; the same card pays more.

floors.author: dengdeng
floors.text: 逻辑判断那种题最值钱，要动脑子；弹幕、垃圾短信这种看一眼就行的次之；手写数字最便宜。
floors.textEn: Logic questions pay best because you have to think. Danmaku and spam, where one glance is enough, come next. Handwritten digits pay least.

floors.author: akazhan
floors.text: 接模型外包要先有成绩：人家要拦截准确率 92%，你 90% 人家不签。
floors.textEn: For model contracts you need results first: if they want 92% filter accuracy, 90% does not get signed.

floors.author: dengdeng
floors.text: 对。签下来是按天给钱的，准确率越高给得越多，比手标稳。
floors.textEn: Right. A signed job pays every day, and more the better your accuracy. Steadier than labelling.

floors.author: yanglaji
floors.text: 电费记得交，欠费停电了啥都白搭。
floors.textEn: Pay the power bill. Once it is cut off, nothing works.

threads.author: liandan
threads.title: 每天守着电脑点训练？教你偷懒
threads.titleEn: Sitting there clicking Train all day? How to slack off

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 挂个 crontab 定时训练，人不用守着；再弄成后台进程，关了窗口它也在练。
floors.textEn: Add a crontab to train on a timer so you need not sit there; then make it a daemon so it trains with the window closed.

floors.author: xiaobai
floors.text: 那标注能偷懒吗？
floors.textEn: Can I slack off on labelling too?

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 标注没捷径，老老实实手标。想走捷径的都去买挂机脚本了，你去众包那帖看看他们啥下场。
floors.textEn: There is no shortcut for labelling: do it by hand. The ones who wanted a shortcut bought click scripts. Look at the crowd-task thread to see how that went.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 手标也不亏：哪些题难、错在哪，标多了心里有数。
floors.textEn: Hand labelling is not wasted either: label enough and you know which cards are hard and where the mistakes come from.

threads.author: xiaobai
threads.title: 练了几百轮死活不涨，是我人品问题吗
threads.titleEn: Hundreds of epochs and it will not improve. Is it my karma?

floors.author: xiaobai
floors.text: 分数卡在一个地方，再怎么练都上不去。
floors.textEn: The score is stuck at one level. More training does nothing.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 不是人品，是结构到顶了。光加轮数没用，得换结构或者换训练方法。
floors.textEn: Not karma. The structure has hit its ceiling. More epochs will not help; change the structure or how you train.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 先看诊断：错题都错在哪一类？近的对远的错，还是简单的对复杂的错？错的规律就是答案。
floors.textEn: Look at the diagnosis first: what kind of cards does it get wrong? Near right and far wrong, or simple right and complex wrong? The pattern of mistakes is the answer.

floors.author: haixing
floors.text: 这行每隔几年就撞一次墙，每次都是新论文把墙推倒的。
floors.textEn: This field hits a wall every few years, and every time a new paper knocks it down.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 还有，练得不够多是看不出问题的。别跑两轮就下结论，多跑一阵，墙自己会露出来。
floors.textEn: Also, you will not see the problem without enough training. Do not judge after two epochs; run it a while and the wall shows itself.

floors.author: chigua
floors.text: 听说有人卖「秘籍」，就是把论文结论直接告诉你。
floors.textEn: I hear people sell "cheat sheets" that just tell you the paper's conclusion.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 买了省事，自己琢磨出来更爽，平台还有奖金。
floors.textEn: Buying saves time. Working it out yourself feels better, and the platform pays a bonus for it.

threads.author: kedaibiao
threads.title: loss 一夜之间变成 NaN，科普一下学习率
threads.titleEn: Loss turned into NaN overnight: a primer on learning rate

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 学习率就是每一步迈多大。迈太大会跳过最低点，越跳越远，最后溢出成 NaN。
floors.textEn: The learning rate is how big each step is. Too big and it jumps past the minimum, further each time, until it overflows into NaN.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 一般 0.1 起步，炸了就往小调；越往后模型越复杂，越要小，0.01 甚至 0.001。
floors.textEn: Usually start at 0.1 and go smaller if it blows up. The more complex the model, the smaller: 0.01 or even 0.001.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 再加一个「梯度裁剪」：步子再大也不让超过一个上限。循环网络必备。
floors.textEn: Add gradient clipping too: however big the step, it never exceeds a cap. A must for recurrent networks.

floors.author: xiaobai
floors.text: 阶跃函数也不行吗？我用的就是阶跃。
floors.textEn: Is a step function no good either? That is what I use.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 阶跃没有坡度，误差传不回去，多层网络学不动。换 S 形或者 ReLU。
floors.textEn: A step has no slope, so the error cannot flow back and a multi-layer net cannot learn. Use an S-curve or ReLU.

threads.author: xiaobai
threads.title: RNN 读到句子后面，前面的全忘了
threads.titleEn: My RNN forgets the start of the sentence by the end

floors.author: xiaobai
floors.text: 短句子挺准，长一点就不行，问它开头说了啥一脸懵。
floors.textEn: Short sentences are fine. Longer ones fail: ask about the beginning and it has no idea.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 普通循环网络就是金鱼记忆，信息一个字一个字往后传，传远了就没了。
floors.textEn: A plain recurrent net has a goldfish memory: information is passed along word by word and fades with distance.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 97 年那篇 LSTM，给它加几道门，让它自己决定记什么、忘什么。
floors.textEn: The 1997 LSTM paper: give it gates so it decides what to keep and what to forget.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: LSTM 配梯度裁剪，学习率压到 0.01 以下，宽度给够。一次只改一样，对比远距离那一行的分数。
floors.textEn: LSTM with gradient clipping, learning rate at 0.01 or lower, and enough width. Change one thing at a time and compare the long-distance row.

threads.author: liandan
threads.title: 层数堆到 20 层以上，效果反而变差？
threads.titleEn: Past 20 layers it gets worse, not better?

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 不是过拟合，训练集都变差。每一层都让信号打个折，叠多了就没了。
floors.textEn: It is not overfitting; even the training score drops. Every layer weakens the signal a little, and stacked deep enough it is gone.

floors.author: haixing
floors.text: 去年那篇 ResNet：每层留条捷径，让信号能原样跳过去。
floors.textEn: Last year's ResNet paper: give every layer a shortcut so the signal can skip it unchanged.

floors.author: xiaobai
floors.text: 所以设置里那个「跨层直连」就是干这个的？
floors.textEn: So that skip connection setting is for this?

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 对，开了再往深堆。
floors.textEn: Yes. Turn it on, then go deeper.

threads.author: kedaibiao
threads.title: 做机器翻译，逐字翻出来全是中式英语
threads.titleEn: Machine translation word by word comes out as Chinglish

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 逐字对逐字永远不通顺，因为两种语言语序不一样。
floors.textEn: Word for word never reads right, because the two languages order words differently.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 先把整句读完压成一个意思，再从头用另一种语言说一遍。编码器 + 解码器，宽度至少 256。
floors.textEn: Read the whole sentence into one meaning first, then say it again from the start in the other language. Encoder plus decoder, width 256 at least.

floors.author: haixing
floors.text: 再进一步就是注意力：说每个词的时候回头看原句对应的地方。
floors.textEn: One step further is attention: when saying each word, look back at the matching part of the original.

threads.author: haixing
threads.title: 循环网络太慢了，能不能一口气并行算
threads.titleEn: Recurrent nets are too slow. Can we compute it all in parallel?

floors.author: haixing
floors.text: 循环只能一个字一个字算，卡再多也用不上。
floors.textEn: A loop computes one word at a time; more cards do not help.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 把循环拿掉，只留注意力：每个字直接看所有字。
floors.textEn: Remove the loop and keep only attention: every word looks at every other word directly.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 但没了循环它就不知道谁先谁后了，得给每个位置打个编号。
floors.textEn: But without the loop it no longer knows the order. Give each position a number.

floors.author: chigua
floors.text: 你们说的这个，会不会就是以后的大模型？
floors.textEn: Could this be what the big models will be later?

threads.author: yanglaji
threads.title: 听说大公司一次用几千张卡训模型，家里能玩吗
threads.titleEn: Big companies train on thousands of cards at once. Can you do it at home?

floors.author: yanglaji
floors.text: 家里一台机箱 3500 瓦就到头了，再加卡就跳闸。
floors.textEn: One case at home tops out at 3500 W. Add more cards and the breaker trips.

floors.author: akazhan
floors.text: 要么租机房，整排机柜专线供电。
floors.textEn: Or rent a server room: whole racks on a dedicated line.

floors.author: liandan
floors.text: 规模上去了，有些本事是突然出来的，之前一点征兆都没有。模型要够宽够深，数据要够多。
floors.textEn: Once the scale is there, some abilities appear all at once with no warning before. The model has to be wide and deep enough, and the data big enough.

threads.author: guaji
threads.title: 众包挂机脚本，日入 300？
threads.titleEn: A crowd-task click script: ¥300 a day?

floors.author: guaji
floors.text: 摆渡众包挂机脚本，自动答题，一晚上不用管，日入 300 不是梦。要的私聊，包教包会。
floors.textEn: A click script for Bodu Crowdsourcing: it answers the cards by itself, leave it running all night, ¥300 a day is no dream. DM me, I'll teach you how.

floors.author: xiaobai
floors.text: 真的假的？求链接。
floors.textEn: For real? Link please.

floors.author: chigua
floors.text: 被封了，抽检全错。
floors.textEn: Got banned. Every spot check came back wrong.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 脚本只会全选『是』，傻子都看得出来。
floors.textEn: The script only ever picks 'Yes'. Any fool can see that.

floors.author: laozhou
floors.text: 标注这活我也干过，标到最后手是麻的。
floors.textEn: I've done this labelling work too. By the end my hand was numb.

floors.author: haixing
floors.text: 要是脚本真认得字就好了。
floors.textEn: If only the script could actually read.

floors.author: xiezhi
floors.text: 谢邀，蹲一个后续。
floors.textEn: Thanks for the invite. Waiting for an update.

threads.author: kedaibiao
threads.title: 众包里有『金标题』，别拿脚本碰
threads.titleEn: Crowd tasks have 'golden items'. Keep your scripts away

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 科普一下：摆渡众包会在题里混一些平台早就知道答案的题，叫金标题。看着和普通题一模一样，但每一道都会被抽检，错一道罚得比普通题狠得多。
floors.textEn: A quick explainer: Bodu Crowdsourcing mixes in cards whose answers it already knows. They are called golden items. They look exactly like ordinary cards, but every one is checked, and a wrong one is fined far harder than usual.

floors.author: chigua
floors.text: 怪不得我一晚上被罚了好几百……同一道题错了好几回。
floors.textEn: So that is why I was fined hundreds in one night... the same card came back wrong several times.

floors.author: kedaibiao
floors.text: 金标题就那么十几道翻来覆去地用。被抽过一次就记下来，下次再见到别自动交，人工看一眼。
floors.textEn: There are only a dozen or so per task, used over and over. Once one has been checked, remember it; next time it shows up, do not auto-submit it, have a human look.

floors.author: guaji
floors.text: 我的脚本升级了，现在能认出金标题，要的私聊。
floors.textEn: My script got an upgrade and recognises golden items now. DM me.

floors.author: xiezhi
floors.text: 谢邀，楼上号已经被封了。
floors.textEn: Thanks for the invite. The poster above just got banned.
